route.deposit.exact.tooltip: Try to PUT the EXACT amount(s) specified TO the target inventory. If the courier does not have the stack EXACTLY, or it cannot COMPLETELY fit in the destination, it will NOT transfer.
route.deposit.match.tooltip: Try to PUT ANY matches TO the target inventory. Stack sizes are ignored - will fill until target is full of matches or courier no longer holds any.
route.deposit.no_match.tooltip: Try to PUT ALL items EXCEPT the matches TO the target inventory. Stack sizes are ignored - will fill until target with non-matches until full or courier no longer has any.
route.deposit.ratio.tooltip: Try to PUT a specified ratio of matching items TO the target inventory. Item stack size in the filter determines the ratio where a stack of 2 is half, 3 is a third, etc.
route.fill.minimum.tooltip: Try to FILL a MINIMUM of the amount(s) specified TO the target inventory. Same as 'Fill Upto', except it will only put items if the target will result in having AT LEAST this amount. This check if performed PER STACK.
route.fill.upto.tooltip: Try to FILL target inventory TO these amounts. Courier will not deposit anything if the inventory already has these stack sizes (or more).
route.take.minimum.tooltip: Try to TAKE a MINIMUM of the amount(s) specified FROM the target inventory. Same as 'Take Upto', except it will only take items if the courier will result in having AT LEAST this amount. This check if performed PER STACK.
route.take.upto.tooltip: Try to TAKE these amounts FROM target inventory. Courier will not take anything if they are already carrying the specified numbers (or more) in the backpack.
route.withdraw.exact.tooltip: Try to TAKE the EXACT amount(s) specified FROM the target inventory. If a stack does not exist EXACTLY in the target, or the courier cannot COMPLETELY hold it, it will NOT transfer.
route.withdraw.match.tooltip: Try to TAKE ANY matches FROM the target inventory. Stack sizes are ignored - courier will take all matches until backpack full or inventory no longer has any.
route.withdraw.no_match.tooltip: Try to TAKE ALL items EXCEPT the matches FROM the target inventory. Stack sizes are ignored - courier will take all non-matches until backpack full or inventory no longer has any.
route.withdraw.ratio.tooltip: Try to TAKE a specified ratio of matching items FROM the target inventory. Item stack size in the filter determines the ratio where a stack of 2 is half, 3 is a third, etc.

npc.thought.event.no_reach.1: I couldn't find a way to the spot I was sent to, so I left it alone.
npc.thought.event.no_reach.2: That spot was out of my reach. I'll try something else for now.
npc.thought.event.no_reach.3: I tried to get to my task but there is no path. Moving on.
npc.thought.event.no_job.1: I looked around for work and found nothing I could do.
npc.thought.event.no_job.2: No job for me today, it seems.
npc.thought.event.no_job.3: Nobody has any work for me right now.

npc.thought.event.got_job.2: I've got a new post: the %1$s.
npc.thought.event.got_job.3: Off to the %1$s, that's where I'm needed.

npc.thought.event.ate.3: I filled my belly from the stores.

npc.thought.event.ate_inn.2: The innkeeper served me a good meal.
npc.thought.event.ate_inn.3: I ate at the inn and enjoyed every bite.

npc.thought.event.slept.3: I got up from my bed, ready for the day.

npc.thought.event.rested_hall.2: No bed again, so I lay down next to the hall.
npc.thought.event.rested_hall.3: I slept rough by the town hall.
npc.thought.event.fled.1: I ran away when I saw %1$s coming.
npc.thought.event.fled.2: I fled from %1$s. I'm no fighter.
npc.thought.event.fled.3: %1$s scared me, so I took off.

npc.thought.event.near_death.2: I almost didn't make it. My heart is still pounding.
npc.thought.event.near_death.3: One more hit and I would have been done for.
npc.thought.event.starving.1: I'm starving and there is nothing to eat!
npc.thought.event.starving.2: My stomach is empty, I'm starving.
npc.thought.event.starving.3: I haven't eaten in ages. I'm starving.
npc.thought.event.no_food.1: I was hungry but found no food in the storage.
npc.thought.event.no_food.2: The storage has no food for me.
npc.thought.event.no_food.3: I went looking for food and found none.
npc.thought.event.ship_arrived.1: We reached the spot I was told to sail to.
npc.thought.event.ship_arrived.2: Anchored where I was ordered. Waiting for the next word.
npc.thought.event.ship_arrived.3: The ship is where it should be. I'll hold her here.

npc.thought.event.ship_stuck.2: Shallows and rocks all round. I gave up on that course.
npc.thought.event.ship_stuck.3: The ship wouldn't get any further, so I stopped her.

npc.thought.event.ship_unreachable.2: That ship was too far out for me to reach.
npc.thought.event.ship_unreachable.3: I tried to get aboard but could not reach the ship.
npc.thought.event.ship_no_food.1: There is no food aboard, and I can't leave my post.
npc.thought.event.ship_no_food.2: I'm hungry, and the ship has nothing for me to eat.
npc.thought.event.ship_no_food.3: No food in the hold. I'll have to bear the hunger.

npc.thought.event.no_tool.2: There is no tool for me in the storage.

npc.thought.event.homeless.3: Everybody else has a bed but me.
